task.problem_statement: The PySCF chemistry backend currently returns only the full configuration interaction energy. Users also need the corresponding ground-state wavefunction in Tequila qubit representation for comparison with the molecular Hamiltonian.
requirements: When requested, return both the full configuration interaction energy and its quantum wavefunction.
Preserve the fermionic phase and spin-orbital ordering so that the returned wavefunction agrees with the molecular Hamiltonian ground state up to global phase.
Preserve the energy-only behavior and existing molecular Hamiltonian and reference-state functionality.

interface.Name: QuantumChemistryPySCF.compute_fci
interface.Description: Returns the energy by default, or energy and wavefunction when get_wfn=True; available on Molecule instances using the PySCF backend.
